cases.expect: Candidate exposure sets differ by type, phase and licence.
Causal promotion rejected.

cases.input: A propagation licence requests prerequisite-to-dependent traversal over a type whose pinned definition declares neither symmetry nor an inverse pairing.
cases.expect: The traversal is rejected as unlicensed inverse derivation.

cases.input: An API change at a prerequisite propagates to its dependents over types that permit licensed inverse derivation at contract and runtime phase.
cases.expect: The run proceeds, the counter-canonical direction is recorded on the licence, and no converse edge is stored.

cases.input: Traversal composes an interface edge with a package edge where no TypeCompositionRule exists for the pair.
cases.expect: The path does not compose and traversal halts at the type boundary with a stop reason.

cases.input: A cycle spans two types, one permitting cycles and one forbidding them, and traversal proceeds on the permissive rule.
cases.expect: The traversal is rejected; heterogeneous cycle permission is the conjunction of all participating type rules.

cases.input: A resource-delay traversal reaches an adjacency-class co-location edge.
cases.expect: Traversal halts with a stop reason code; the adjacency edge is reported and never propagates.

cases.input: A scenario pins propagationProfileRef to a profile that has no version, no release state and no digest.
cases.expect: The scenario is rejected because deny-by-default licensing cannot be evidenced against an unversioned profile.

cases.input: A licence reduced to a single boolean is used for both the API-change and the resource-delay events on one frozen graph.
cases.expect: The runs are rejected; a licence that cannot carry type, phase, lag and unknown-edge policy cannot separate the two events.

cases.input: The scenario creates its own graph snapshot record rather than referencing one minted on the dependency-edge side.
cases.expect: The snapshot is rejected; the analysis references snapshots and never masters them.

cases.input: Two scenarios are executed over the identical frozen graph state.
cases.expect: Both pin the same graphSnapshotRef and the same digest under a named digestAlgorithm and canonicalizationMethod, and their outputs are comparable.

cases.input: A snapshot digest is recorded with no digestAlgorithm and no canonicalizationMethod.
cases.expect: The pin is rejected because immutability and staleness detection are not verifiable.

cases.input: A candidate path traverses an edge in the unknown state and the result is published as a completed exposure set.
cases.expect: Traversal halts at the unknown edge, the edge is reported on the unexpanded frontier with a reason code, and completeness falls.

cases.input: Traversal reaches an asserted-absent edge under a profile declaring unknownEdgePolicy.
cases.expect: The branch terminates with a distinct reason code that does not collapse asserted-absent into unknown.

cases.input: A successorRef is written onto a released scenario when a correction is issued.
cases.expect: The write is rejected; supersession is recorded in a separate link record.

cases.input: A covering graph snapshot changes after release.
cases.expect: A status evaluation overlay records evaluatedStatus 'stale' with its basis and timestamp; the released scenario record is byte-identical before and after.

cases.input: A scenario with no completenessRef publishes conclusionPolarity 'negative' for a subject.
cases.expect: The conclusion is rejected; a scenario with no completeness pin is permanently indeterminate.

cases.input: A released scenario that pinned no completeness declaration remains released while the underlying completeness declaration is withdrawn, and continues to be cited as evidence of no impact.
cases.expect: The citation is rejected; absence of a completeness pin must make staleness unevaluable and the conclusion indeterminate, not durable.

cases.input: A completeness declaration covering subject set S, kinds K, phases P and interval I is pinned by a scenario whose exposure set falls inside S, K, P and whose execution time falls inside I.
cases.expect: Coverage evaluates true and a negative conclusion is admissible.

cases.input: A completeness declaration scoped to the build phase is pinned by a runtime-phase scenario drawing a negative conclusion.
cases.expect: Coverage evaluates false and the negative conclusion is rejected.

cases.input: A scenario reaches status 'executed' with no exposureSet, no stopReasons and no unexpandedFrontier.
cases.expect: The status transition is rejected; outputs are required from executed onward.

cases.input: Edges are omitted from traversal by licence, depth limit and phase filter.
cases.expect: Each omitted edge appears in suppressedEdges with a reason code resolved against a pinned code list.

cases.input: Stop reason and suppression reason codes are emitted with no codeListRefs pinned on the scenario.
cases.expect: The output is rejected; reason codes must resolve against pinned code list versions.

cases.input: The scenario output set is published as the affected set with no assessor determination.
cases.expect: The label is rejected; the scenario may publish only a candidate exposure set.

cases.input: An API change and a resource delay are run on one frozen graph under different type filters, phase windows and licences.
cases.expect: The candidate exposure sets differ by type, phase and licence rather than topology, and neither is labelled affected or not-affected.

cases.input: A lag annotation on an edge is treated as authorisation to propagate across it.
cases.expect: The propagation is rejected; lag is a temporal annotation and grants no propagation or causal licence.

cases.input: A licensed traversal path is promoted directly to a causal attribution.
cases.expect: The promotion is rejected; causal attribution requires a separate WM-KNW-007 claim with evidence, scope, confidence and defeaters.

cases.input: A released scenario output is recorded directly as a WM-KNW-015 risk determination.
cases.expect: The recording is rejected; risk may consume a scenario but is never computed by the traversal.
